question: What were the total expenditures (in millions of nominal dollars) for U.S national defense in the calendar year of 1940?
raw_response:
The image confirms the National defense column values for each month of 1940:

Jan 132, Feb 129, Mar 143, Apr 159, May 154, Jun 153, Jul 177, Aug 200, Sep 219, Oct 287, Nov 376 (r), Dec 473.

These match the markdown parse exactly. Summing the 12 calendar-year-1940 months = 2602 million dollars.

This is the proper way to get a calendar-year figure (the fiscal-year table earlier only gives July-June periods). The data is in millions of nominal dollars as requested.

<FINAL_ANSWER>2602</FINAL_ANSWER>
